headlines.title: Kornacki: 43% of voters want midterm vote to ‘signal opposition to Trump’
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki joins Meet the Press to take a look at NBC News’ latest poll on how voters feel about both parties headed into the midterm elections.

headlines.title: ICE officer shoots Venezuelan man delivering food in Austin, Texas, lawyer says
headlines.description: An ICE officer shot and seriously wounded a Venezuelan man Sunday afternoon as he was delivering food in Austin, Texas, his lawyer said.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: Journalists from MS NOW, CNN and Politico were denied access to the White House grounds Saturday, a day after President Donald Trump said on social media that he had banned the news outlets over what he called their “constant ‘reporting’ FAKE NEWS.”

headlines.title: Patrick Mahomes and Kenneth Walker shine as Chiefs beat Colts 33-30 in OT
headlines.description: Harrison Butker kicked two field goals in overtime, the second a 40-yarder that Patrick Mahomes and Kenneth Walker III set up as time expired, giving the Kansas City Chiefs a 33-30 victory over the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday night.

headlines.title: Trump announces new plan for D.C. arch
headlines.description: President Trump said in a Truth Social post Sunday that he would convert plans for a Washington, D.C.-area “Triumphal Arch” to those for “a top grade Military Complex/Triumphal Arch” at the request of the U.S. military, citing “national security.” NBC News’ Julie Tsirkin reports.

headlines.title: New Found Glory founder and guitarist Chad Gilbert dead at 45
headlines.description: New Found Glory guitarist Chad Gilbert died “peacefully in his sleep” Sunday morning at the age of 45, his bandmates and wife said in a statement.

headlines.title: American dream of owning a home out of reach for many as mortgage rates soar (again)
headlines.description: Interest rates on a 30-year fixed mortgage soared to 7.2%. Coupled with near record high prices, it’s putting homeownership out of reach for millions.

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: U.S. proposes exchanging AI safety alerts with China, Bessent says
headlines.description: The United States has proposed a new AI safety notification mechanism for President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping to consider at their summit in Washington this week, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Sunday.

headlines.title: Patrick Clancy talks about grief, forgiveness and the future with ‘60 Minutes’ after Lindsay Clancy mistrial
headlines.description: In his first interview since his ex-wife’s trial, Patrick Clancy opened up about his grief at losing his three children and said that he tried his best before the tragic killings in Massachusetts.

headlines.title: They entered the season as Super Bowl hopefuls. Now the odds are against them.
headlines.description: The Los Angeles and Houston Texans -- who entered as Super Bowl contenders -- will face an uphill climb to simply make the playoffs after starting the season 0-2.
